mapper.sql: c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.parent_comment_id, c.root_comment_id, c.content, c.created_at, u.username AS author_username, u.display_name AS author_display_name, pu.username AS reply_to_username, (SELECT count(*) FROM comment_likes l WHERE l.comment_id = c.id) AS like_count, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comment_likes l WHERE l.comment_id = c.id AND l.user_id = #{viewerId}) AS liked, (SELECT count(*) FROM comments r WHERE r.parent_comment_id = c.id) AS reply_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM comments r WHERE r.root_comment_id = c.id) AS thread_reply_count
FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN comments pc ON pc.id = c.parent_comment_id LEFT JOIN users pu ON pu.id = pc.user_id
